legend: Bile duct exfoliative cytopathology shows a micropapillary epithelial tissue fragment with mildly increased N:C ratio and mucin production (liquid-based cytopathology, Pap).

Bile duct exfoliative cytopathology from a 37-year-old man with IgG4-related sclerosing cholangitis. An atypical epithelial tissue fragment with mildly increased N:C ratio and mildly irregular nuclear membranes (liquid-based cytopathology, Pap).
